 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace/programs/task-3cd81cc5.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v != 0).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # The template is the compact non-background, nonzero object; the zero
    # rectangle is its destination. Reflect the template left-to-right there.
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
           if g[r][c] not in (bg, 0)]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
    template = [g[r][c0:c1 + 1] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]

    zpts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == 0]
    zr0, zr1 = min(r for r, c in zpts), max(r for r, c in zpts)
    zc0, zc1 = min(c for r, c in zpts), max(c for r, c in zpts)
    for dr in range(zr1 - zr0 + 1):
        for dc in range(zc1 - zc0 + 1):
            g[zr0 + dr][zc0 + dc] = template[dr][len(template[0]) - 1 - dc]
    return g
"
}
